home.title: Request your credentials
home.lead: Services published by issuers on Almena ID. Apply with your Almena wallet and keep the credential in it.
home.empty: No issuer has published a service yet.
home.unavailable: The catalog cannot be reached right now. Try again in a moment.
home.loadError: The rest of the catalog could not be loaded.

apply.title: Application
apply.asksTitle: What you will be asked for
apply.howPair: Scan a code with your Almena wallet: it pairs with this issuer under a key of its own.
apply.howFill: Fill in the form: present the credentials asked for from your wallet, type the rest and attach the files.
apply.howSubmit: Scan a second code: your wallet shows what you send, you sign it and it goes to {issuer}.
apply.pairLead: Scan this code with your Almena wallet to start your application to {issuer}.
apply.credentialsLead: Present them from your wallet: the fields they fill come verified, and you do not type them.
apply.submitLead: Scan this code: your wallet shows everything you send to {issuer}; sign it there to send it.
apply.gone: This application is not open in this browser, or it expired: an application not sent within a day is removed.

statusLead.submitted: {issuer} has your application for {type}: it will check it and decide.
statusLead.rejected: {issuer} did not accept your application for {type}.

problems.format: This is not written as expected.
problems.range: This is outside what is accepted.

presentation.issuer_untrusted: Its issuer is not one this form trusts.
presentation.trust_framework_unsupported: This credential cannot be verified yet.
presentation.claims_missing: It lacks data the form needs.
presentation.holder_binding_invalid: It is not bound to your wallet.

errors.answers_incomplete: Complete the form, and present the credentials it needs, before sending.
errors.application_closed: This application has already been sent.
errors.nothing_to_present: This form asks for no credentials.
errors.file_type_invalid: That kind of file is not accepted here.
errors.file_too_large: The file is larger than 10 MB.
errors.gone: This application is not open in this browser.
errors.unavailable: The registry cannot be reached. Try again in a moment.

apply.receiveLead: Scan this code with the wallet you applied with: only that wallet can take it.
apply.credentialSuspended: {issuer} has suspended this credential: verifiers refuse it for now.
apply.credentialRevoked: {issuer} has revoked this credential: verifiers no longer accept it.

wallet.failed: The registry cannot be reached. Try again in a moment.
